info.name: Plerion API Documentation Alerts Risks API

params.name: ids
params.description: Filter by risk IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: fields
params.description: Select specific risk fields to include in the response. Only applies to risk properties. Accepts a comma-separated list of risk fields. Example fields: id, name, severityLevel, score

params.name: riskTypeIds
params.description: Filter by risk type IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: environmentIds
params.description:
Filter risks on the environment. This parameter accepts any combination of environment name or environment IDs (UUIDs) in a comma-separated list.

**Supported environment names:**
- `production` - Production environment
- `non-production` - Non-production environment

params.name: integrationIds
params.description: Filter by integration IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: primaryAssetIds
params.description: Filter by primary asset IDs. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: severityLevels
params.description: Filter by severity levels. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: lifecycleStates
params.description: Filter by lifecycle states. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: resourceTypes
params.description: Filter by resource types. Accepts a comma-separated list.

params.name: discoveredAtStart
params.description: Start of the date range for filtering risks based on the discovered date.  Specify the start of the range using a valid ISO 8601 date-time string.  If `discoveredAtStart` is provided and `discoveredAtEnd` is omitted,  results will include risks from this date to the present. Supported formats include: - `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (e.g., `2025-02-18T08:00:00Z`) - `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ` (e.g., `2025-02-18T08:00:00.000Z`)

params.name: discoveredAtEnd
params.description: End of the date range for filtering risks based on the discovered date. Specify the end of the range using a valid ISO 8601 date-time string.  If `discoveredAtEnd` is provided and `discoveredAtStart` is omitted,  results will include risks up to this date. Supported formats include: - `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (e.g., `2025-02-18T08:00:00Z`) - `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ` (e.g., `2025-02-18T08:00:00.000Z`)

params.name: include
params.description: This parameter is for loading relationships in the risk response. Available options: - `primaryAsset`: includes the complete primary asset object for each risk - `integration`: includes the complete integration object for each risk

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Order the list by supported field. Can accept `discoveredAt` or `score`. The default is `discoveredAt`.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order of the list. Can accept `asc` or `desc`. The default is `desc`.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Get the next batch of risks. Used for pagination.

items.docs: Use the list risks API to retrieve and filter risks across the tenant.
